feats.title: Starfire Womb
feats.description: When you deal damage with a power that has the radiant or fear keyword, immediately roll a saving throw to relieve a condition of your choice from which you are suffering.

feats.title: Improved Fate of the Void
feats.description: Your Fate of the Void grants an additional +1 bonus to the d20 roll.

feats.title: Sacrifice to Caiphon
feats.description: When you attack with a Warlock encounter power that has targets and you miss all targets, then you can deal damage to yourself equal to the level of the power. If you do, you immediately recover the power.

feats.title: Improved Dark One's Blessing
feats.description: Your Dark One's Blessing now gives you 3 additional temporary hit points.

feats.title: Allegiance to the Daughter
feats.description: Whenever you reduce an enemy you have cursed to 0 hit points with a Warlock attack, the enemy's space fills with hellfire until the end of your next turn. Any creature that enters or starts its turn within the square takes fire damage equal to 5 + one-half your level.

feats.title: Glasya's Rebuke
feats.description: Each time a target takes damage from hellish rebuke because you took damage, one enemy within 5 squares of the target also takes 5 fire damage.

feats.title: Improved Misty Step
feats.description: Your Misty Step now allows you to teleport an additional 2 squares.

feats.title: Bloodied Boon
feats.description: You can choose to gain your pact boon when an enemy you curse is first bloodied. If you do, you remove your curse from that enemy.

feats.title: Primed Curse
feats.description: The bonus to attack rolls granted by Prime Shot increases to +2 if the target is also cursed by you.

feats.title: Cursed Shot
feats.description: When determining who is nearest for the purposes of the Prime Shot class feature, you ignore all allies adjacent to you, as well as allies who are helpless, stunned, dominated, unconscious, or petrified.

feats.title: Empowering Shadows
feats.description: When you have concealment from your Shadow Walk, you gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls.

feats.title: Brutal Curse
feats.description: When you roll your Warlock's Curse damage, reroll any die that displays a 1 until you have a result of 2 or higher.

feats.title: Prolonged Curse
feats.description: When you hit a target with a Warlock attack that deals ongoing damage, increase the ongoing damage by 1 point per Warlock's Curse die you roll.

feats.title: Killing Curse
feats.description: The extra damage dice from your Warlock's Curse class feature increase from d6s to d8s.

feats.title: Curse of Displacement
feats.description: When you score a critical hit against the target of your Warlock's Curse, you teleport the target 3 squares as a free action.

feats.title: Exultant Shadow Step
feats.description: When you score a critical hit against the target of your Warlock's Curse, you can teleport 4 squares as a free action.

feats.title: Warlock's Sight
feats.description: You don't take the normal -2 penalty to attack rolls if your target has cover or concealment as long as your target is cursed by you.

feats.title: Yorgrix's Brutality
feats.description: When you damage a creature with a Warlock attack power while that creature is taking ongoing damage, the creature takes 2 extra poison damage. The extra damage increases to 4 at 11th level and to 6 at 21st level.

feats.title: Cruel Whimsy
feats.description: When an enemy fails a saving throw against an effect bestowed by one of your Warlock powers, you can shift 1 square as a free action.

feats.title: Ulban's Flare
feats.description: When you hit a creature with dire radiance and you have concealment or total concealment from that target, the target takes 2 extra damage and a -2 penalty to attack rolls until the end of your next turn. The extra damage increases to 4 at 11th level and to 6 at 21st level.
